introduction: Explore the City of Brass, its shrines, zoo, harbor and palace. Gather the tax collector’s four collectibles for palace access, fulfill Herl’s blood request and Yodono’s three-head request, find the hidden spy’s six-head mission, and understand the separate guarded bracer commission and unfinished djinn branch.
orientation: Active, ready accounting is required for discovery, visible encounters, journals and new achievement/daily credit. Discovering Brass has its own achievement. Asking aliases, reading notes, carried preparation, kills and attempted access do not record accepted quest outcomes.

Enter from Plane of Fire room 25455 at city entrance 139000. The first golem guards north; death of the second golem clears the separately blocked north gate. A closed door still needs opening. Actor defeat, barrier clearing and surviving passage are distinct facts.

Most of Brass is fire-plane terrain. Shared heat behavior can remove ordinary fire-protection spells; a fire-ward potion alone does not establish safe travel. Account for actual protection, survival, perception, door state and placement. The Flaming Dragon Inn at 139078 is a real assigned rental service.

The tax collector at office 139020 wants four exact collectibles, including two special coin objects rather than wallet payment. The Surtr and Imix shrines, dock master and magma lake supply the declared inputs. One accepted QA exchange yields the palace key; key possession is not palace arrival.

The Palace Gate Key opens the forward north gate at 139140 and has a one-hundred-percent break value. Reverse palace door state differs. Trace the actual door reset and current shared state before treating a configured key as a mandatory historical prerequisite.

Yodono at 139217 accepts three distinct heads and yields two identical-kind cold-blue-flame vials. The potion’s spell is elemental form, not healing. His narrated second task and the unplaced dying djinn’s empty vial recipe have no verified rescue endpoint; that empty exchange is excluded from named progress.

The hidden spy starts in Magma Lake 139238 with nominal ten-percent placement, accepts six distinct heads for an airy sash and departs. Two heads overlap Yodono’s request; spend a new copy for each accepted request. Actual visible encounter and renewable recipient supply require qualification.

The armorer’s bracer needs both elder and ancient pyrohydra scales plus 7500 platinum. This mixed fee remains guarded under durable accounting. The smaller elder-scales-plus-fee exchange returns the same kind and fee as a refusal and earns no achievement or daily.

The ten-headed pyrohydra is declared in rare room 139247 with sixty-percent placement. Its non-sentinel movement may bring it into the palace via outward exits; there is no reviewed ordinary incoming exit into that birth room. Normal unforced active-accounting resets skip lower-chance M commands, and legacy item resets require admitted generation.

The palace has distinct front/rear routes, green and purple-fire side keys, two different blue-fire throne keys, a treasury key, armory/slave-quarter key and a locked armoire’s skeleton key. Alternate entry and asymmetric reverse states matter. No local switch or portal prototype implements a new access quest.

Shanaanaa sells external-zone notes. Their narratives can help future mapping, but buying/reading them does not dynamically prove those gates, passwords, quests or routes. Nine note kinds are configured stock; Transparent Tower notes require actual carried-stock availability. Imported artifact/stat-pool/epic effects remain separate interactions.

The city bank, shops, shrine imagery, guild titles, floating pools, prisoner lore and Sultan battle do not add accepted native story terminals. Builders can select successful access, rescue, dialogue, source or campaign events later. Preserve current acceptance and exclusions while recording missing capabilities and balanced repair proposals.

contacts.name: an Unquenchable
contacts.description: The Unquenchable palace gate guards start at 139140. Their hi/hello MA response is room-visible context; it does not accept the palace key, prove emissary status or award an achievement.

contacts.name: Herl the ranger lord
contacts.description: Herl starts at trophy market 139181 and requests chimaera blood for 1000 platinum. He also has an ordinary shop; the specific rare-beast request and regular commerce are distinct.

contacts.name: a dying djinn
contacts.description: The dying djinn prototype has an empty greeting and a vial-consuming native recipe without response, reward or disappearance. No active M/F/R placement was found. Its intended second-task or rescue endpoint needs builder design; do not offer a vial on the assumption it heals him.

contacts.name: the efreeti tax collector
contacts.description: The tax collector starts at office 139020, not the temple room sharing his VNUM. His four collectible inputs yield the palace key. Topics explain the zoo, docks, lake, markets and slave trade without granting completed objectives.

contacts.name: an efreeti armorer
contacts.description: The armorer starts at shop 139024. The complete two-scale/7500-platinum commission is a guarded equipment service. The lesser one-scale/fee exchange is a refusal; returned prototype kind is not proof of identical physical UID.

contacts.name: Yodono the efreeti magi shop owner
contacts.description: Yodono starts at magic-device market 139217. Three exact heads yield two vials of cold blue flames. His qc_action family lacks the interval expected by the ambient routine and is not a player topic. The narrated second task has no verified completed endpoint.

contacts.name: a hidden djinni spy
contacts.description: The hidden spy is declared at Magma Lake 139238 with ten-percent placement. “Nearby steam spout” is dialogue imagery, not a dedicated steam-spout room. Six exact heads yield the airy sash, then the spy departs.

contacts.name: an iron golem
contacts.description: The imported first iron golem starts at city entrance 139000. Its guild_guard procedure blocks north for ordinary players while it remains at its birth room. It does not clear the gate’s blocked flag.

contacts.name: an iron golem
contacts.description: The imported second iron golem also starts at 139000. Its unblock_on_death procedure reads qc_unblock 139000 north from plane_fire_one.qst and removes EX_BLOCKED on death. Opening the remaining closed door and clearing the other guard are separate.

contacts.name: Caltoon the efreeti magi master
contacts.description: Caltoon starts at the grand magi chamber 139041 and carries his head for Yodono. He is a separate actor from the palace arch-magi.

contacts.name: a padashaw arch-magi
contacts.description: The palace arch-magi starts in laboratory 139299 carrying his head and imported lightning rod. Both Yodono and the spy require a separate copy of his head.

contacts.name: the efreeti padashaw Ornon Kasoon
contacts.description: Ornon Kasoon starts in main chamber 139292 carrying his head and purple-fire key. His head is shared by two independent requests; the hall has a separate rear approach.

contacts.name: the efreeti padashaw Artoon Branan
contacts.description: Artoon Branan starts in 139286 carrying his head for the spy. The green-fire front lock does not prove all approaches require that key.

contacts.name: a padashaw high priest
contacts.description: The palace high priest starts in 139330 carrying his head. El’Quilan in the city temple is a distinct cleric.

contacts.name: the efreeti padashaw Wrinyen Otis
contacts.description: Wrinyen Otis starts in training room 139336 carrying his head and brass armory key. Several forward slave-quarter doors and the armory use that key, with different reverse reset states.

contacts.name: the efreeti padashaw Hakim Okewonaku
contacts.description: Hakim Okewonaku starts in flying mount pen 139344 carrying his head for the spy. Mounted and following creatures do not own that proof.

contacts.name: a fire giant priest
contacts.description: The Surtr priest starts at shrine 139178 with the Surtr collectible coin. His following and neighboring priests are different owners.

contacts.name: an Imix priest
contacts.description: The Imix priest starts at shrine 139246 with the Imix collectible coin. The nearby flame and priests are not that exact coin’s source.

contacts.name: a dockmaster
contacts.description: The dock master starts at 139192 and declares the flaming quill equipped in slot 18. The preceding same-slot brass dagger is moved to carried inventory if both resets are admitted.

contacts.name: an ancient chimaera
contacts.description: The ancient chimaera starts in zoo cage 139091 with the blood for Herl. Its “grey bird” room text conflicts with the grey-bearded lion body description and remains a pending wording proposal.

contacts.name: an elder hydra
contacts.description: The elder hydra starts in zoo cage 139085 and declares the elder scales with eighty-percent item chance. Its six heads and the ten-headed pyrohydra are distinct creatures.

contacts.name: a ten-headed pyrohydra
contacts.description: The ten-headed pyrohydra is declared in rare-load room 139247 with sixty-percent placement and may wander through its outward exits. It carries ancient scales for the guarded bracer service; source presence is not guaranteed.

contacts.name: Shanaanaa
contacts.description: Shanaanaa starts at information emporium 139215. Nine external-zone note kinds are configured shop stock; Transparent Tower notes are carried-only reset stock. Buying or reading clues does not verify the described foreign quest mechanics.

contacts.name: Shadam Quilen, the Efreeti Sultan
contacts.description: Sultan Shadam Quilen starts in throne room 139312 carrying the treasury key, holy flamberge and epic monolith. The two distinct blue-fire keys lead through separate throne doors. His defeat and treasury access have no native named request receipt.

contacts.name: the chief efreeti guard
contacts.description: The chief of the guard starts in 139351 carrying the flaming skeleton key for the locked armory armoire. The armoire contains imported band of emerald flames; recovering it is separate from the spy and native turn-ins.

stories.title: Herl’s exotic blood request
stories.summary: Herl asks for one drop of chimaera blood and pays 1000 platinum (1000000 copper). The ancient chimaera starts in zoo cage 139091 with the declared blood. This is a named rare-beast delivery with a currency reward; ordinary buying and selling are separate services. Supplied exact blood fits without a personal kill or recovery history.

steps.hint: Ancient chimaera 139144 starts in zoo cage 139091 and declares this blood as G inventory, nominal chance one hundred percent and cap one. The mob’s copied “grey bird” wording does not create a different source. Recover the exact kind into loose carried inventory. Supplied matching material fits. Current possession does not record original source, first recovery, a personal kill, unlocking or arrival.

Its QA response goes to the room; delivery does not record personal recovery or opening the palace gate.

Head acceptance is one outcome, separate from your own combat, secrecy, infiltration or all-city campaign completion. Actual placement, perception and renewal need qualification.
